messages:
Maya: Noticing consistent confusion in support tickets when users open per-route views: three separate icons (cost, latency, fallback) are overwhelming. Proposal: introduce a single compact 'capacity hint' pill that surfaces a one-line summary + expandable details. Keeps console tidy.

Ethan: Love this. One-line should be deterministic and explain: typical latency bucket, burn estimate (tokens/min), and whether route uses fallbacks or Dedicated. Suggest colors only as accents, not primary signal.

Riya: Implementation question  Should this be server-calculated on render or stored when the saved view is created/edited? If we compute on render we can show live info; if stored we can support audits. Maybe both: realtime by default, snapshot optional.

Connor: API tradeoff: I prefer keeping server logic centralized. Console should call a hint endpoint with saved_query_id and get back a canonical hint object. Payload example I sketched:

```
GET /api/v1/saved-queries/{id}/capacity-hint?mode=live

Response 200
{
  "hint_version":"v1",
  "mode":"live",
  "latency_tier":"p50:fast p95:moderate",
  "tokens_per_call_est":260,
  "burn_per_min_est":5200,
  "fallback_to":"redwood-lite",
  "quota_pressure":"low",
  "confidence":"medium",
  "sample_count":132
}
```

This avoids passing full filters from the console. Server looks up the latest routing and model pins.

Tess: Important: include model_variant_hash and rollout_tag so hint consumers know which model the numbers correspond to. Otherwise pinning/unpinning invalidates hints silently.

Maya: UX: show pill text like: "≈120ms · ~260 tok/call · fallback:redwood-lite · [low confidence]". Expand reveals full numbers, last-sampled-at, and "refresh" CTA. Avoid alarmist words.

Ethan: Confidence buckets should be consistent across console. Propose thresholds: low <50 samples, med 50-500, high >500. Also show a tiny info icon that explains sample windows (last 24h by default).

Riya: Quota signal: compute projected burn as tokens_per_call_est * recent_qps. If projected >75% of quota mark "quota pressure: elevated". But do not surface quotas to orgs that don't own them (e.g., infra-owned shared routes) unless they have permission.

Connor: For private deployments, server may not have aggregated telemetry. API should return data_source: "local-agent" and include which heuristics were used. Show a tooltip "estimated from local metrics".

infra-bot: New feature flag created: feature.console.capacity_hint (default: off). Canary plan: internal alpha --> 5% orgs --> 25% orgs over 3 weeks.

Tess: Accessibility: text alternatives and non-color affordances required. Also keyboard focus should expand pill.

Maya: Edge-case: very low-traffic routes can have noisy p95. We should suppress p95 and show just p50 + confidence for sample_count < 20.

Ethan: Debate: id-only vs filters-in-payload. I'm for id-only because routing & pin rules live on server. If console needs deterministic preview (e.g., before save), console can call a preview mode with full filters. So two endpoints: preview (filters) and canonical (id).

Riya: Agree. preview endpoint should be rate-limited and require auth scope "preview:queries". Also provide force_refresh=true param to trigger on-demand sampling job (async with progress).

Connor: Storage/migration: add columns to saved_queries table: hint_snapshot_blob (json), hint_snapshot_at, hint_snapshot_source, hint_version. Keep blobs small (strip heavy telemetry arrays).

Tess: Telemetry events to capture: capacity_hint_shown, capacity_hint_refreshed, capacity_hint_used_in_decision. Include hint_version and sample_count. We'll need these to analyze stale vs useful.

Maya: Rollout blockers: ensure eng-sre signs off on quota calc formula. Also UI should not show quota pressure for orgs with no visibility. Tagging @eng-sre.

Ethan: Security: saved_query owners should be able to opt-out of snapshotting hints (sensitive routes). Add saved_query.allow_hint_snapshots boolean.

Riya: Action items: Connor + Tess spec APIs + auth, Ethan + Maya design pill + copy, Infra to wire feature flag, I (Riya) will draft migration SQL and telemetry schema.

Connor: I'll post an API swagger by EOD and include simulated responses for private vs hosted.

Tess: I'll prototype three pill states in Figma: high confidence, low confidence, and "no data" with CTA to sample.

Maya: Thanks team. Let's sync in tomorrow's product sync with a short demo if pieces ready.

infra-bot: feature flag rollout scheduled: feature.console.capacity_hint -> ramping 5% -> 25% -> 100% (approx dates TBD).
